_description: Privacy Policy for the Sessiz Kelime mobile app by Sogepps. Data processing information suitable for Google Play publishing.
intro: As Sessiz Kelime ("App"), we care about user privacy. This policy explains the data usage approach of the mobile app.
s1_p1: Sessiz Kelime does not require creating an account, logging in, or sharing mandatory personal data.
s1_p2: Data created during gameplay and possibly kept on the device may include:
s1_li1: Player / team names you enter for the session
s1_li2: Scores, round progress and game settings for the current session
s1_li3: Timer, pass allowance, category and language preferences
s1_p3: By default, this information is kept only on your device.
s2_p1: Anonymous technical data may be collected to improve stability and performance:
s2_li1: Device type and operating system version
s2_p2: This data does not include player names or game content.
s3_p1: The mobile version may use advertising or analytics services (e.g. Google AdMob).
s3_p2: The data processing practices of these services are governed by their own privacy policies. You can limit personalized ads from your device settings.
s4_p1: We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13.
s5_p1: Reasonable technical measures are applied for data security. Local data may be deleted from the device when the app is uninstalled.
s6_p1: Privacy policy updates are published on this page along with the date they take effect.
